events.content:
### Publish Data via Ingest API (Python)

Source: https://github.com/514-labs/moosestack/blob/main/apps/framework-docs-v2/content/moosestack/streaming/from-your-code.mdx

Use this method to automatically create an API endpoint for ingesting data into a stream. Configure the IngestPipeline with `ingest_api=True`. Data is published via HTTP POST requests.

```python
import requests
from moose_lib import IngestPipeline, IngestPipelineConfig

# When you create an IngestPipeline with ingest_api: True, Moose automatically creates an API endpoint
raw_data = IngestPipeline[RawData]("raw_data", IngestPipelineConfig(
  ingest_api=True, # Creates POST /ingest/raw_data endpoint
  stream=True,
  table=True
))

# You can then publish data via HTTP POST requests
response = requests.post('/ingest/raw_data', json={
  'id': '123',
  'value': 42
})
```

--------------------------------

### Publish Data via Ingest API (TypeScript)

Source: https://github.com/514-labs/moosestack/blob/main/apps/framework-docs-v2/content/moosestack/streaming/from-your-code.mdx

Use this method to automatically create an API endpoint for ingesting data into a stream. Configure the IngestPipeline with `ingestApi: true`. Data is published via HTTP POST requests.

```typescript
const rawData = new IngestPipeline<RawData>("raw_data", {
  ingestApi: true, // Creates POST /ingest/raw_data endpoint
  stream: true,
  table: true
});

// You can then publish data via HTTP POST requests
const response = await fetch('/ingest/raw_data', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    id: '123',
    value: 42
  })
});
```

--------------------------------

### Test Ingestion API Endpoint (Curl)

Source: https://github.com/514-labs/moosestack/blob/main/apps/framework-docs-v2/content/guides/static-report-generation.mdx

Sends a POST request to the sales ingestion API with a minimal valid payload. Use this to test data ingestion and identify type mismatches.

```bash
# Test with minimal valid payload
curl -X POST http://localhost:4000/ingest/sales \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"transactionId":"TEST-001","saleTimestamp":"2025-01-15T10:00:00Z","storeId":"STORE-001","region":"West","productId":"PROD-001","productCategory":"Electronics","customerId":"","quantity":1,"unitPrice":10.00,"totalAmount":10.00}'
```

--------------------------------

### Send Data to Ingestion API (TypeScript)

Source: https://github.com/514-labs/moosestack/blob/main/apps/framework-docs-v2/content/moosestack/streaming/sync-to-table.mdx

Use this snippet to send event data to the Moose ingestion API. Ensure the Content-Type header is set to application/json.

```typescript
// 1. Data sent to ingestion API
fetch('http://localhost:4000/ingest/events', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    id: 'evt_123',
    userId: 'user_456',
    timestamp: '2024-01-15T10:30:00Z',
    eventType: 'click'
  })
})
```

--------------------------------

### Send Data to Ingestion API (Python)

Source: https://github.com/514-labs/moosestack/blob/main/apps/framework-docs-v2/content/moosestack/streaming/sync-to-table.mdx

Use this snippet to send event data to the Moose ingestion API using Python's requests library. The data is sent as JSON.

```python
# 1. Data sent to ingestion API  
requests.post('http://localhost:4000/ingest/events', json={
    "id": "evt_123",
    "user_id": "user_456",
    "timestamp": "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z", 
    "event_type": "click"
```
